# a2s

## NAME

**a2s**

## SYNOPSIS

`a2s [OPTIONS]`

## DESCRIPTION

A command-line utility for querying and diagnosing game servers via the Steam A2S protocol. It provides server information, player lists, and rules, checks server availability, and runs a caching proxy.

## OPTIONS

### Application Options

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-t`, `--timeout`|Set request timeout|`3s`|`$A2S_TIMEOUT`|no|
|`-b`, `--buffer-size`|Set connection buffer size|`8192`|`$A2S_BUFFER_SIZE`|no|

### Help Options

|Option|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`-h`, `--help`|Show this help message|no|
|`-v`, `--version`|Show version information|no|

### all

Retrieve all available server information

Query server metadata, rules, and players in one command.

**Usage:** `a2s [OPTIONS] all [all-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

```text
a2s all 127.0.0.1:27015 --format json
```

#### Retrieve all available server information

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-f`, `--format`|Output format; choices: `json, table, md, html`|`table`|`$A2S_FORMAT`|no|
|`-g`, `--game`|Game type for more accurate results; choices: `dayz, arma3`||`$A2S_GAME`|no|
|`-r`, `--raw`|Disable parse A2S_RULES values to types||`$A2S_RAW`|no|

#### Arguments

|Name|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`host`|Server host (with optional port, e.g., 127.0.0.1:27016)|yes|
|`port`|Query port (if not included in host)|no|

### ping

Ping the server with A2S_INFO

Measure server response time with repeated A2S_INFO queries.

**Usage:** `a2s [OPTIONS] ping [ping-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

```text
a2s ping 127.0.0.1:27015 --ping-count 5
```

```text

```

```text

```

```text
a2s ping 127.0.0.1:27015 --query players --compact
```

#### Ping the server with A2S_INFO

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-q`, `--query`|A2S query to measure; choices: `info, players, rules`|`info`|`$A2S_QUERY`|no|
|`-c`, `--ping-count`|Set the number of ping requests to send (0 = infinite)|`0`|`$A2S_PING_COUNT`|no|
|`-p`, `--ping-period`|Set the period between pings|`1s`|`$A2S_PING_PERIOD`|no|
|`--compact`|Print only response times in milliseconds||`$A2S_COMPACT`|no|
|`--no-summary`|Disable final statistics||`$A2S_NO_SUMMARY`|no|

### proxy

Run a cached A2S proxy

Expose a cached UDP proxy for an upstream A2S server. Optional rate limits reduce application-level CPU and response traffic abuse; they do not replace host or provider DDoS protection.

**Usage:** `a2s [OPTIONS] proxy [proxy-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

```text
a2s proxy 127.0.0.1:27015 --listen :27016
```

```text
a2s proxy 127.0.0.1:27015 --listen :27016 --cache info --cache players --cache rules --ttl 30s
```

```text
a2s proxy 127.0.0.1:27015 --listen :27016 --rate-limit 1000 --rate-client-limit 30 --rate-window 1s
```

#### Run a cached A2S proxy

|Option|Description|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|
|`-l`, `--listen`|Local UDP endpoint to listen on|`$A2S_LISTEN`|yes|
|`--upstream-ping`|Forward A2A_PING instead of answering locally|`$A2S_UPSTREAM_PING`|no|

#### Cache Options

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`-c`, `--cache`|Response types to cache; choices: `info, players, rules, auto, none`|`auto`|`$A2S_CACHE`|no|
|`-T`, `--ttl`|Cache refresh interval|`15s`|`$A2S_TTL`|no|
|`--inactive-ttl`|Inactive cache retry interval (0 = use TTL)|`0`|`$A2S_INACTIVE_TTL`|no|
|`-j`, `--jitter`|Maximum polling interval jitter|`1s`|`$A2S_JITTER`|no|
|`-r`, `--retries`|Retries after an upstream refresh failure|`2`|`$A2S_RETRIES`|no|

#### Rate Limit Options

|Option|Description|Default|Environment|Required|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|`--rate-limit`|Global proxy request limit (0 = disabled)|`0`|`$A2S_RATE_LIMIT`|no|
|`--rate-client-limit`|Per-client proxy request limit (0 = disabled)|`0`|`$A2S_RATE_CLIENT_LIMIT`|no|
|`--rate-window`|Rate limit window|`1s`|`$A2S_RATE_WINDOW`|no|

#### Arguments

|Name|Description|Required|
|---|---|---|
|`host`|Server host (with optional port, e.g., 127.0.0.1:27016)|yes|
|`port`|Query port (if not included in host)|no|

### rules

Retrieve server rules A2S_RULES

Query server rules with A2S_RULES or automatic A3SB parsing.

**Usage:** `a2s [OPTIONS] rules [rules-OPTIONS]`

#### Examples

```text

```

```text

```
